offering_description.value: Manufactures and sells chocolate and sugar candies, including chewy candies, lollipops, caramels, mints, and bubble gum. Sells to retailers and wholesalers, who in turn reach consumers. Products are made in company-owned plants in the US, Canada and Mexico.

primary_products.value: chewy candies; lollipops; caramels; hard candies and mints; bubble gum

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery, mass merchandise, drug, convenience and club retailers, wholesalers and distributors, vending and foodservice accounts

end_markets.value: confectionery; grocery retail; convenience retail; snacks

revenue_model.value: product sales: candy sold to retailers and wholesalers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes candy from purchased sugar, corn syrup, cocoa and packaging, sold under its own brands to retailers and distributors; brand owner: owns and markets its own candy brands

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico, with some export sales to other countries

specialization.value: related lines: chewy candy, lollipops, caramels, mints and gum, all sold to the same retail channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff and brokers selling to large retail chains; distributors / dealers: wholesale candy and grocery distributors, including vending distributors; agents / brokers: food brokers covering retail accounts
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food manufacturing and labeling rules enforced by the FDA and Canadian and Mexican food authorities
